start: Member app, Gym tab, at the gym's desk; the member's number is on the gym's list

steps.action: Tap 'Check in', point the scanner at the gym's QR poster
user_sees: Checked in, with the gym's name, the first name and whether the plan is fine today
'Other gym' with the member's own gym name (OTHER_GYM)
must_not: A visit saved at a gym the member does not belong to

steps.action: Try more than 10 times in a minute, or more than 3 different numbers in a day
user_sees: 'Too many tries, wait a minute' (TOO_MANY / TOO_MANY_NUMBERS)
Already in, with the time of the first check-in
must_not: A time of 1970 for a visit with no time
